attempt_summary.cumulative_important_progress: No proof or counterexample to the root statement was found; the root is Kawamata's still-open D/K-equivalence conjecture (active status memo M-21853103147c48109c5dc4d16f83df43). A concrete high-quality near-counterexample was fully analyzed. For a very general degree-4 K3 surface S, the sixfolds X=M_H(0,H,0)=relative Pic^2 and Y=M_H(0,H,1)=relative Pic^3 are smooth projective hyperkahler varieties with trivial canonical bundles. Exact Mukai-lattice computation gives obstruction-class orders 4 and 1, and Addington--Donovan--Meachan yields a twisted equivalence D^b(X,alpha^3) ~= D^b(Y) with nontrivial order-4 twist. Beckmann's derived-invariant extended Mukai lattice together with Mattei--Meinsma gives discriminants 4 and 16 and therefore proves failure of untwisted derived equivalence. However, direct Neron-Severi computations give Gram determinants -1 and -16; Huybrechts's birational H^2 theorem then proves X and Y are not birational, hence not K-equivalent. Thus the candidate fails precisely at the indispensable common-birational-resolution gate. The exact calculations were staged under OP-05ea4b89-9825-49cd-af46-2e8b4be330e5. More broadly, the theorem of Maulik--Shen--Yin--Zhang that all birational hyperkahler varieties of K3^[n]-type are derived equivalent excludes this entire deformation type as a source of counterexamples. This supplies the requested rigorous no-go result for a plausible twisted/Brauer mechanism without falsely resolving the general conjecture.
attempt_summary.most_promising_next_steps: Search generalized Kummer and O'Grady deformation types, where no analogous all-birational-pairs theorem was found: enumerate explicit projective birational wall-crossing models, verify crepantness, and compute Yang's 2025 integral derived-invariant lattice (plus Brauer/universal-sheaf data) on both sides. In parallel, examine genuinely high-dimensional non-toroidal flops outside established Fourier--Mukai/VGIT cases, always separating birationality, crepantness, and untwisted categorical obstructions.
